text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - L'Oreal issued its estimated consolidated 1996 results in a statement. After a review by the board and by statutory auditors, results will be given final approval on April 22.

L'Oreal said 1996 sales, reflecting the consolidation of acquisitions Maybelline, Jade and Interbeauty for the first time, were up 13.1 percent from 1995 levels. They rose eight percent on a comparable basis.
Group operating profit rose 17.5 percent to 7.36 billion francs.
Profit before tax, employee profit-sharing and capital gains and losses rose 12.7 percent. "This increase was achieved despite the rise in interest expenses due to acquisitions," the statement said.

Corporate tax rose 14.8 percent and the portion paid to minority interests also increased, reflecting growth in Synthelabo's earnings, it said. "Consequently net profit before capital gains and losses, after minority interests, which is used to calculate earnings per share, reached 3.73 billion francs, up 10.3 percent," it said.
